drivers.name: Marcus Reed
drivers.bio: Ran a UPS route for six years, so he knows every loading-dock door in DuPage. Front desks remember him by the second visit.

drivers.name: Elena Vargas
drivers.bio: Former salon coordinator. Talks to stylists and nail techs like a colleague, because she was one.

drivers.name: Omar Haddad
drivers.bio: Personal trainer on weekends. Gym owners give him the floor manager instead of the brush-off.

drivers.name: Tasha Greene
drivers.bio: Twelve years in hospitality. Runs the ten-stop days: early start, nothing missed, every card counted.

drivers.name: Danny Kowalski
drivers.bio: Covers the Downers Grove and Westmont side when the regular driver is out.

drivers.name: Priya Nair
drivers.bio: Newest on the team. Shadowing the ten-stop routes before taking her own.
